message.content:
Based on my search, I found information about two different "Glenwood Pools" - one is the world-famous **Glenwood Hot Springs Pool** in Glenwood Springs, Colorado, and the other is **Glenwood Pool**, a community swim club in Forest Glen, Maryland. Here's what I found:

---

## Glenwood Hot Springs Pool (Colorado)

The **Glenwood Hot Springs Pool** is the world's largest outdoor mineral hot springs pool, located in Glenwood Springs, Colorado. Here are the key details:

### History
- **Established:** 1888 by Walter Devereux
- The Ute Native Americans originally called the springs "Yampah" meaning "Big Medicine" and were the first known visitors to these mineral-rich hot springs
- The original red sandstone bath house and lodge was built in 1890 for $100,000
- During WWII (1943-1946), the resort served as a U.S. Naval Convalescent Hospital
- The pool has been operated by local families since 1954

### Pool Specifications
- **Water source:** Yampah Spring, flowing 3.5 million gallons per day at 122°F (51°C)
- **Grand Pool:** 405 feet long × 100 feet wide (123 × 30 meters); temperature: 90°-93°F (32°-34°C); holds 1,071,000 gallons
- **Therapy Pool:** 100 feet long × 40 feet wide (30 × 12 meters); temperature: 104°F (40°C); holds 91,000 gallons
- Features: diving board, 4 lap lanes

### Amenities & Recent Additions
- **Sopris Splash Zone** (opened 2019): Includes Shoshone Chutes river tube ride (700 feet long, ~2.5-3 minute run), interactive splash pad, and children's area
- **Yampah Mineral Baths** (opened Memorial Day 2023): New soaking pools including infinity pool, cold plunge pool (52-60°F), and waterfall pools
- **New in 2024:** Five additional pools including cold plunge, cold pool, infinity pool, and two waterfall pools
- Glenwood Hot Springs Lodge (107 rooms, built 1986)
- Athletic Club with spa services and fitness center
- Poolside Grill restaurant

### Pricing (as of recent information)
- **Adult Winter:** $38-$51/person
- **Adult Summer:** $51-$55/person
- **Youth Winter:** $27-$33/person
- **Youth Summer:** $33-$34/person

### Location & Hours
- **Address:** 401 N River St, Glenwood Springs, CO 81601
- Open daily, typically 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. (hours vary by season)
- About 40 miles from Aspen on Highway 82

---

## Glenwood Pool (Maryland)

**Glenwood Pool** is a private community swim club located in **Forest Glen, Maryland** (Silver Spring area). It is set back among trees along a creek in a historic neighborhood.

### Features
- Community swim club open to the public (subject to availability)
- Swim teams (Glenwood Tigers)
- Recently underwent renovations (new pool construction planned as of 2003 newsletters)
- Family-friendly environment with social events

### Contact
- **Website:** glenwoodpool.org
- **Email:** board@glenwoodpool.org

---

4. https://letsjetkids.com/glenwood-hot-springs-with-kids/
5. https://glenwoodpool.org/glenwood-e-newsletter-volume-1-issue-1/

8. https://hotspringspool.com/blogs/the-fascinating-history-of-glenwood-hot-springs-resort/
9. https://soprissun.com/balancing-modernization-with-history/
